scenes.title: Another World
scenes.text: Mars is another world where a day lasts twenty four hours and thirty seven minutes, almost exactly like ours.
scenes.hook: THERE IS A PLANET NEXT DOOR

scenes.title: Smaller Earth
scenes.text: Mars is about half the size of Earth, with gravity only a third as strong, so you could jump three times higher.

scenes.title: Giant Volcano
scenes.text: Mars holds the tallest volcano in the solar system, rising twenty two kilometers, nearly three times Mount Everest.

scenes.title: Robots Land
scenes.text: Robots have been driving across the red planet for over a decade, sending back pictures from a place no human has seen.

scenes.title: Long Trip
scenes.text: It takes about seven months to reach Mars, and the distance between the two planets changes every single day.

scenes.title: Tiny Moons
scenes.text: Mars has two small moons, and one is slowly spiraling in and will eventually break apart.

scenes.title: Why Red
scenes.text: The planet looks red because its soil is full of iron oxide, the same rust you see on an old nail.

scenes.title: Your Turn
scenes.text: Mars could be our second home one day. Would you go if you had the chance, even with no way back?
